relationships.subject: Hydrogen-producing silicon-based agent
relationships.evidence_quote: hydrogen produced by a Si-based agent regulates the pyroptosis of microglia may through the NLRP3-caspase-1-GSDMD pathway

relationships.subject: Hydrogen-producing silicon-based agent
relationships.evidence_quote: The results demonstrated that the Si-based agent reduced the infiltration of inflammatory cells and the degree of neural demyelination.

relationships.subject: NLRP3
relationships.evidence_quote: We discovered that increased expression of the NLRP3 inflammasome and inflammatory cell infiltration occurred concurrently with demyelination of the trigeminal ganglion in TN rats.

key_findings: Intra-intestinal hydrogen-producing Si-based agent reduced inflammatory infiltration and trigeminal ganglion demyelination in trigeminal neuralgia rats.
Effect linked to inhibition of microglial pyroptosis via the NLRP3-caspase-1-GSDMD pathway.
